notes: This contract records provider-specific C++ TCK evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.13.4.4 Table 31: RTI_TIMEOUT_HEART and RTI_TIMEOUT_PURGE are configurable through an RTI Initialization Data (RID) profile. The current-process adapter writes an Umbra-specific RID file, starts the process service host through its RID-loading constructor, then observes inactive-member removal through the official C++ API. RID location and file syntax are Umbra implementation choices. This does not establish provider-neutral RID syntax, all Table 31 rows, conformance, or interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: RTI_TIMEOUT_HEART and RTI_TIMEOUT_PURGE configuration through RID
